name: XAttention: Block-Sparse Coarse-to-Fine Routing with Unified Soft
description: XAttention: Block Sparse Attention with Coarse-to-Fine Routing.  Partitions sequence tokens into non-overlapping blocks, evaluates coarse block-level routing, and computes unified normalized fine-grained attention across top-k candidate blocks, with multi-architecture weight transfer, trainable LoRA residual adapters, GQA, RoPE, and causal decoding.  Hardened for production across DistilBERT, RoBE
